_comment: Which rail each capacitor sits on, and what that rail runs at.
The rated voltage is NOT here -- it is read from the parts list
at run time, so a corrected BOM corrects this too.
A16A1 has one electrolytic, C52. The rest are ceramic and polyester.

C52.note: Reservoir on the +5 RLH relay-driver supply after choke L4, sheet 5700A-1071 zone A8. The rail is A17's +5 RLH, +5.55 V to +6.40 V (Table 2-10), so the applied voltage is its top of band. Table 6-21 prints 15 uF 35 V; the sheet annotates it 10 uF/35V. Either way a 35 V part on 6 V has a generous margin.
